title: Childcare Waitlists
abstract: arXiv:2610.12732v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Parents seeking childcare often face long waitlists. At the same time, vacancies at childcare centers can remain unfilled for extended periods. We trace this paradox to two persistent features of childcare services. First, families consider multiple child care options due to enrollment uncertainties, resulting in phantom listings that remain on waitlists even after families have found care elsewhere or no longer need a slot. Second, filling a slot is time-consuming: centers learn whether a family is actively seeking enrollment only after making an offer and waiting for a response. As families pursue alternatives while they wait and their children age, these delays and feedback effects amplify the mismatch between demand and available capacity.   We study two operational remedies. First, we examine regular verification that removes phantom listings before offers are made, improving the efficiency of enrollment and reducing vacancies. Se

translated_abstract: 寻找托儿服务的家长常常面临漫长的等待名单。与此同时，托儿中心的空位却可能长期无人填补。我们将这一悖论归结为托儿服务的两个持久特征。首先，由于入学的不确定性，家庭会同时考虑多个托儿选项，从而产生“幽灵名单”——即使家庭已经在别处找到托儿服务或不再需要名额，他们仍留在等待名单上。其次，填补一个空位非常耗时：托儿中心只有在发出录取通知并等待回复后，才能知道一个家庭是否真正在积极寻求入学。随着家庭在等待期间寻求其他选择以及孩子年龄的增长，这些延迟和反馈效应放大了需求与可用容量之间的不匹配。我们研究了两种运营补救措施。首先，我们考察了定期验证机制，即在发出录取通知之前清除幽灵名单，从而提高入学效率并减少空位。
tldr: 论文揭示了托儿服务中“家长排队漫长”与“托儿中心空位闲置”并存的悖论源于家庭多重申请造成的幽灵名单和冗长的录取确认流程，并提出通过定期验证清除幽灵名单等运营措施来提高入学效率、减少空位。
